没在白名单里时，系统在省电/待机状态会掐断应用的后台网络。系统弹窗里点一次「允许: While the app isn't whitelisted, the system cuts off its background network in power saving or standby. Tapping “Allow” once in the system dialog is enough.
这一层是各手机厂商自己的开关，应用读不到也改不了。到系统设置的「应用启动管理 /: These switches belong to each phone vendor; the app can neither read nor change them. In the system settings under “App launch management / Autostart”, turn on autostart, associated startup and background activity. Left at their defaults, the app is frozen in the background — the “OrbDrop is running” notification stays in the shade, yet peers no longer see you and nothing they send arrives.
部分厂商还有一层不在自启动页上：它会连前台服务一起冻住 —— 熄屏后进程停摆，通: Some vendors have another layer that isn't on the autostart page: it freezes even foreground services — with the screen off the process stops while the notification stays, and peers see you as offline. In the system settings under “Battery / Power management”, find OrbDrop and choose “Allow background activity” or “Allow high power use in background” (names vary by vendor).
收消息时的提醒。关掉它不影响后台在线，但你不会知道有人找你。: Alerts when messages arrive. Turning this off doesn't affect staying online in the background, but you won't know someone is trying to reach you.
横幅要求这条渠道是\"高\"及以上（只有\"高\"才会在屏幕顶部弹出来）。部分手: Banners require this channel to be “High” or above (only “High” pops up at the top of the screen). Some vendors add their own switch that holds it back (such as “Silent notifications” or “Banners”); the app can't read that layer — a quick look inside will confirm it.

退出「{title}」？本机不再收发这个群的消息，本机这份聊天记录也会一起删掉；: Leave “{title}”? This device stops sending and receiving messages in this group, and its copy of the chat history is deleted too; other members are unaffected.

调整群发或群聊的参与设备。: Change which devices take part in the broadcast or group chat.
给这台设备起一个只存在本机的名字（不发给对端）：会话与标题只写备注本身，设备页那: Give this device a name that exists only on this device (it isn't sent to the peer): conversations and titles use the remark alone, while the row on the Devices page shows “remark (device name)”.
对端不认本机的凭据（它清过数据，或换了机器）：拨号必然被拒，重新配对换一枚新 t: The peer doesn't recognise this device's credentials (it cleared its data or moved to another machine), so every dial is rejected. Pair again to get a fresh token.
到配对表里完成配对。未配对也能发消息（HTTP 兜底），但拨不动长连接、也读不到: Finish pairing on the pairing screen. You can still send messages while unpaired (HTTP fallback), but the long-lived connection can't be dialled and the peer's shared items can't be read.
只清理本机记录，不影响对方。: Only clears this device's copy; the other side is unaffected.
只清本机记录，不退群；之后的新消息照常收。: Only clears this device's copy without leaving the group; new messages still arrive as usual.
本机退出这个群，本机这份记录也随之删除；其他成员不受影响。: This device leaves the group and its copy of the history is deleted; other members are unaffected.
只删这份名单，消息仍留在各台设备的单独会话里。: Only this recipient list is deleted; the messages stay in the individual conversations with each device.
选一台设备建立一对一；选两台以上可用群发或群聊。: Pick one device for a one-to-one chat, or two or more for a broadcast or group chat.
单向：每条消息分别作为单独的一对一消息发给每台设备。: One-way: each message is sent to every device as its own one-to-one message.
共享：所有参与设备都能看到彼此的消息。: Shared: every participating device sees everyone's messages.
等局域网里的设备出现，或到「设备」页手动添加。: Wait for devices on your network to appear, or add one by hand on the Devices page.
发送到「{title}」：流的是它自己的安装包，落盘名叫「应用名_版本名(版本号: Send to “{title}”: the app's own package is streamed and saved as “app name_version name(version code)_package.apk”. Those marked “Split” are installed by the store as split APKs, so sending only the base package may not install on the peer.
发送应用到这条会话。: Send an app to this conversation.

到配对表里选这台设备完成配对。未配对也能发消息（HTTP 兜底），但拨不动长连接: Pick this device on the pairing screen to finish pairing. You can still send messages while unpaired (HTTP fallback), but the long-lived connection can't be dialled and the peer's shared items can't be read.
断链并暂停自动重拨（不是解除配对）：本机不再自动接回，随时可再连。: Drop the link and pause automatic redial (this isn't unpairing): this device won't reconnect on its own, but you can connect again at any time.
配对只确立关系；连上之后本机与对端之间才是实时通道（对端拖入的文件自动广播过来）: Pairing only establishes the relationship; once connected, this device and the peer have a real-time channel (files dropped on the peer are broadcast over automatically).
打开与「{name}」的会话：长连接优先、HTTP 兜底，对端不在网上就排着队等: Open the conversation with “{name}”: long-lived connection first, HTTP as fallback; if the peer is offline, messages queue until it comes online.
移除设备并清理对应系统凭据。: Remove the device and clear its system credentials.
从相册里选（老系统上退回顾照片的\"文件\"应用），选好的图落在输入区里 ——: Pick from the gallery (on older systems this falls back to the file app that browses photos); the image lands in the input area so you can add text before sending. The peer sees it right away.
从系统的文件选择器里选，选好即推送：对端收到一张「接收 / 拒绝」卡，进度与成败: Pick from the system file picker and it's pushed immediately: the peer gets an accept/decline card, and progress and outcome show on that file's bubble in the conversation.
